subject: ukrainian
summary: Ukrainian renders cleanly: Cyrillic text, guillemets and apostrophes are all correct, questions are clear, and the attached reading text is the right passage with no other questions on its first page. Where the scheme is split into separate points (cards 1, 4, 5) it reads well on desktop. The main faults are one comprehension card whose whole sample answer is a single paragraph of about 45 lines on a phone with one tick box, long grey editorial notes at the top of the first scheme box, and an essay card with no criteria and a 0-40 number grid. Paragraph-length scheme points make the phone cards very long.

issues.title: Whole sample answer in one paragraph with one tick
issues.detail: The scheme for this 5-mark discussion question is one unbroken paragraph: 21 lines on desktop and about 45 lines on a phone, spilling into a second screen, with a single 5m tick box halfway down. The other 2025 cards split the same kind of answer into three or four points, so this one looks unfinished.
issues.suggested_fix: Split the sample answer into its sentences or ideas as separate points, as cards 1 and 4 do, under a heading 'Example answer'.

issues.title: Long grey editorial note before the first point
issues.detail: The first scheme box opens with up to 13 lines of small grey text on the phone: the answer-in-Ukrainian rule quoted in full, 'The scheme heads its answer "Наприклад:": what it gives is an example, not a required list', and then the scheme's lead-in sentence quoted inside the note. The lead-in sentence is real answer content but is shown in the small grey style, so it is easy to skip.
issues.suggested_fix: One short line above the boxes: 'Example answer from the scheme - other valid points accepted. Answer in Ukrainian.' Show the lead-in sentence as normal scheme text.

issues.title: Essay card with no criteria and a 0-40 grid
issues.detail: The essay scheme says 'The scheme prints no answer for this part', gives six lines of explanation, and then 41 number buttons under the heading 'Select the points you actually got'. The student has nothing to mark against. The instruction 'write on one of the topics offered below' runs straight into the one quotation shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the grid; show a single plain line and the three self-grade buttons. Put the instruction on its own line above the quotation.

issues.title: Very long phone scroll and no marks per point
issues.detail: Scheme points are full paragraphs of 6 to 12 lines each on a phone, so cards 1, 4 and 5 run to about two and a half phone screens after the reveal. No point carries a mark, so the student ticks points and is then told to 'assess your complete answer against the 5-mark total' without guidance on how many points are enough.
issues.suggested_fix: Give each point a short bold summary (three to six words) with the full text beneath, and say how many points a full-mark answer needs if the scheme says so.

issues.title: Section II card labels the passage 'Частина II'; empty band on phone
issues.detail: The Section II commentary card's attachment is labelled 'READ ЧАСТИНА II' but opens the main reading passage, which is the right material but the wrong label. Every card with an attachment has a blank band of about 200 pixels between the button and the answer box on the phone.
issues.suggested_fix: Label the button 'Read the passage'; collapse the gap.
